people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.
translations.bsb: At this, David sent orders to Joab: “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” So Joab sent him to David.
translations.kjv: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.
